operator_io_quirks: Tiny DB (4/6/6 rows); original read is trivial, no rowid sampling needed.
Mixed-case table names (College, Player, Tryout) and mixed-case columns (cName, pID, pName, yCard, HS, pPos, enr); must double-quote in generated SQL.
DDL uses tabs and multi-line column defs; line-based unique/check scan must tolerate tabs and trailing commas.

numeric(5,0) declared but storage is integer; TS Number fuzzer with scale=5, precision=0, is_int=False (no 'int' substring) -> float perturbation +-0.01/+-0.02, then sqlite affinity coerces to int on insert.
varchar(2) state holds 2-char codes; varchar(3) yCard/decision hold 'yes'/'no' (3 chars) — String fuzzer length range [min,max+1] from elements.
Tryout composite PK (pID, cName) both FK children; both nullable in DDL (notnull=0) though PK implies NOT NULL in sqlite.
FKs Tryout.pID->Player.pID and Tryout.cName->College.cName both resolve; no dangling FKs, no self-refs.
No unique/check constraints beyond PKs; no views/triggers/indexes in DDL.
All columns null_rate=0 in original; TS may still emit NULLs for nullable columns (String/Number samplers don't force non-null).
enr/HS/pID numeric values are small ints (300..22000); Number full range [-10^5,10^5] will produce implausible magnitudes.
pName samples are capitalized first names; String CHARSET a-zA-Z 0-9() will produce garbage names.
Table order: College, Player (level 0), Tryout (level 1) — no cycles.
operator_ts_expectations: College.cName/state, Player.pName/yCard, Tryout.cName/pPos/decision -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length in [min,max+1] of elements, plus 50% contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop char).
College.enr, Player.pID/HS, Tryout.pID -> Number fuzzer scale=5: uniform in [-1e5,1e5] then +-0.01/+-0.02 perturbation; sqlite stores as int via affinity.
yCard/decision 'yes'/'no' will be replaced by random 3-char strings -> queries like yCard='yes' return 0 rows (FN).
state 'LA'/'AZ'/'OK'/'FL' replaced by random 2-char strings -> state='LA' misses (FN).
pPos 'goalie'/'striker'/'mid' replaced by random 8-char strings -> pPos='goalie' misses (FN).
pName 'Andrew' etc replaced by random strings -> pName='Andrew' misses (FN).
enr/HS random large numbers -> enr>20000 or HS<500 predicates may match implausibly or miss (FP/FN).
Tryout FK columns drawn from parent's final values with replacement -> duplicates in (pID,cName) dropped by sample_fresh_primary_keys; ties/duplicates in original (none here) not reproduced.
Composite PK Tryout: max_l0=30 cap on fresh draws; single-col PKs (College.cName, Player.pID) get inf cap -> many distinct keys.
Small table sizes (choose_table_sizes: level0 1+30u, level1 x4 capped 2500) -> Tryout may be much larger than parents, FK draws with replacement create heavy duplication then PK dedup shrinks it.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python; rows violating PK/NOT NULL skipped at insert -> effective row counts may be < requested.
Literal pool from train SQL (e.g. 'ASU','LA','goalie','yes') seeds String elements; with p=0.2 some fresh draws, some element reuse -> partial plausibility.
